verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Dropbox serves an llms.txt at the canonical path (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. However, its visible content reads as consumer marketing (cloud storage, Dash, file migration) rather than developer/API guidance. Markdown doc variants and OpenAPI specs both returned 404. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the developer/API docs, markdown or agent-readable versions of the API documentation, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can use it effectively.
